title: Bump minimatch in app/package-lock.json (Dependabot alert 16)
why: GitHub Dependabot alert 16, medium, open since 2026-11-05: minimatch >= 7.0.0 and < 11.0.1 can be slowed by a crafted glob (denial of service). Read by triage 2026-11-23 17:23 CST: npm package in app/package-lock.json, scope development, patched in 11.0.1.
note: Fix: raise minimatch to 11.0.1 or later in app/package-lock.json, and run the app's checks. It is a dev tool, so it reaches no running server. Not queued as a lane: ask the Orders session or a new lane to take it when free.
